about: Rows the checker evaluates. Signal kinds: blocker (issue: open = broken), fix (PR: merged = fixed, open = in review), release (owner/repo@tag published = fixed), code (owner/repo:path on the default branch; a regex that means fixed or broken), context (shown, never decides), manual (a dated note with a link). Evidence verified 2026-10-24.

rows.name: Trust Wallet Core
rows.note: Builds only v4 Zcash transactions, which NU7 makes invalid. Apps that embed it (Trust Wallet, Vultisig and others) cannot send transparent ZEC after activation until a v5 release ships.

signals.label: Grant application for a Wallet Core v5 repair (under review)

rows.name: Vultisig Android: SwapKit ZEC swaps
rows.note: ZEC-source swaps through SwapKit are signed as Sapling v4 with ZIP-243 digests, and v5 is rejected. The provider builds the transaction, so a fix needs SwapKit as well as the app.

signals.label: Grant application for v5 swap signing (under review)

rows.name: SwapKit: Trezor ZEC signing
rows.note: Moves SwapKit's Trezor Zcash signing to v5, so ZEC received in v6 transactions can be spent.

rows.name: Trezor firmware: v4 path for third-party apps
rows.note: Firmware still sends non-v5 Zcash requests to a v4 signer. Trezor says Suite is unaffected because Connect always asks for v5; third-party integrations that pass version 4 are the ones at risk.

rows.name: Zondax Ledger app (ledger-zcash)
rows.note: No NU7 change found in the repository. Its NU6.3 branch-ID update has been open since 8 Sep.

rows.name: Noir Wallet
rows.note: Every Zcash send has failed on Testnet since NU7 activated there (4 Oct), reproduced again on v1.0.39 on 22 Oct. The same failure reaches Mainnet at activation unless fixed.

rows.name: Zingo (zingolib)
rows.note: Testnet wallets failed with "invalid consensus branch id 0x77190ad9" after Testnet NU7; the issue was closed as fixed. Whether the fix is in a Mainnet release is not checked here.

rows.name: Zodl Android SDK
rows.note: SDK 5.2.2 has no NU7 Mainnet activation height. The open PR moves it to the stable librustzcash crates that carry it.

rows.name: Edge (react-native-zcash)
rows.note: Rebuilds Edge's Zcash SDKs on the final NU7 crates.

rows.name: Zapp (iOS SDK fork)
rows.note: The open PR signs Testnet transactions with the librustzcash NU7 pre-releases; a Mainnet build is a separate step.

rows.name: WebZjs (MetaMask Snap)
rows.note: An unmodified build could not sync on the NU7 Testnet; the maintainers said they would redeploy after NU7.

rows.name: ZNS mint
rows.note: Pins a pre-release Zcash stack that has no Mainnet NU7 height.

rows.name: NEAR Omni Bridge: ZEC
rows.note: The NU7 height is a contract constant, so the new contracts must be deployed on NEAR before block 3,543,405. A merged PR is not yet a deploy.

rows.name: THORChain ZEC
rows.note: ZEC trading was halted around 19 Oct after an outbound matching bug; the fix is in THORChain v3.21.0 (about 23 Oct). No NU7-specific notice found.

rows.name: Maya Protocol ZEC
rows.note: The network halted after a 19 Aug exploit, yet a Maya ZEC route was still quoted on 23 Oct. The sources conflict; treat the route as unconfirmed.

rows.name: sovright mining-infra
rows.note: Open checklist of mining-infrastructure work to finish before Mainnet activation.

rows.name: BitGo (wasm-utxo)
rows.note: The NU7 branch ID is merged in wasm-utxo, which BitGoJS defers to for NU6.2 and later. The BitGoJS PR was closed without merging.

rows.name: librustzcash fork with an early NU7 ID
rows.note: An early fork exposed NU7 as 0x77190AD8. The final ID is 0x77190AD9, so anything built on that pre-release carries the wrong value.

rows.name: librustzcash crates
rows.note: The NU7 Mainnet crate releases are out; wallets built on them still have to ship their own releases.

rows.name: Zebra node
rows.note: Zebra 7.0.0 activates NU7 at 3,543,405 and is supported for 8 weeks. Zebra 6.4.x stops itself around 2 Nov, so nodes must upgrade before then.
